issues.detail: The Hebrew 'צְבִי אֶרֶץ' means 'the glory of the land' or 'the pride of the land', not '地的母鹿' (the doe of the land). The word 'צְבִי' is a noun meaning 'glory/beauty', not 'doe' (which would be 'צְבִיָּה'). This changes the meaning of the verse.

The Hebrew 'קְרִיָּתַיְמָה' (Kiriathaim) is rendered as '基列亞音' (Gilead-ayin?), which appears to be a conflation or misreading. The correct transliteration should be '基列亭' or '基利亞亭' (Kiriathaim). The rendering '基列亞音' introduces a different place name element ('Gilead') not present in the Hebrew.
